verdict.rationale: Elicit ships recurring monitoring through Alerts, which notify you whenever new relevant papers are found. A single doc line also describes 'Routines' that can act on findings, filter on criteria, update an artifact or write a summary, which implies agent workflows that run repeatedly beyond simple alerts. Only one thin mention covers Routines, and none of the evidence shows how scheduling works. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cadence, triggers, time-based runs), details on which workflows Routines can automate, API or programmatic scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
